duumvir.definition:
n. One of two Roman officers or magistrates united in the
   same public functions.
duumvir.translation: n. (担任同一职务的)两执政之一

duumviral.definition: a. Of or belonging to the duumviri or the duumvirate.

duumvirate.definition:
n. The union of two men in the same office; or the office,
   dignity, or government of two men thus associated, as in ancient Rome.
duumvirate.translation: n. 二人执政, 二头政治
